description: This Rust source file implements a custom token storage system for the `yup-oauth2` library, providing encrypted token caching with disk persistence and in-memory caching, including functions for loading, saving, and managing tokens.

classes.name: EncryptedTokenStorage
classes.description: A struct that manages encrypted token storage with disk persistence and in-memory caching.
